column3: NKJV has “saying, ‘She is going to the tomb,’” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “supposing that she was going to the tomb.”
Close to the Greek; “was deeply moved” is rendered “groaned.”
NKJV includes “from the place where the dead man was lying,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “they took away the stone.”
NKJV has “expedient for us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “for you.”
NKJV has the singular “a command,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the plural “commands.”
